source: Make me a game where myself and other players attend classes at a magic academy. We all get chosen for one of three houses (come up with names, color schemes and insignias/emblems for them yourself). For now I want the basis of the game to allow me to explore different classes on my schedule and have activities within them like learning how to make potions or fly on a broom. I earn money to purchase upgrades for my room or to get more eggs for a new partner animal

answers.ask: How large should the campus be - a few buildings around one courtyard, or a sprawling grounds?
answers.answer: Use a compact campus with a few key buildings around one central courtyard, so the first version is easy to explore and plainly playable.

answers.ask: Are classes scheduled events all players attend together, or can you walk into one any time?
answers.answer: Classes should follow each player's schedule, with players able to walk into their scheduled class when it is active rather than requiring everyone to attend together.

answers.ask: Is the room you upgrade inside your house quarter, or somewhere separate?
answers.answer: The upgradeable room is the player's dorm room inside their assigned house quarter.

config.genre_evidence: Players "attend classes at a magic academy," explore a compact campus on "each player's schedule," and upgrade "the player's dorm room inside their assigned house quarter." The potion-making, broom-flying, money earning, and partner-animal eggs are secondary job/activity-sim features within a life-and-school roleplay layout.

extras.text: Three assigned house quarters, each containing player dorm rooms that can be upgraded.
Classrooms activate according to each player's individual schedule.

config.evidence: "compact campus with a few key buildings around one central courtyard" and "player's dorm room inside their assigned house quarter"
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Roleplay & Avatar Sim map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Static Settlement: A fixed, pre-built town with no personal property at all; personalization happens through the avatar, never property.

INCLUDE:
- Town Square Core: A central, deliberately oversized gathering hub built to handle maximum avatar density without traffic jams.
- Pedestrian Circulation: Walkable circulation linking the square to the game's venues — streets, walkways, hallways sized for foot traffic.
- Enterable Interior: Shops, homes, and venues players go inside.
